desc:
(Game inspired by SuperHot)

TIME MOVES WHEN YOU MOVE.

Stand still and the world freezes. Bullets hang in the air. Enemies stop mid-step. Every move you make lets time run. Plan your path, dodge the shot, and strike first.

Fight through a campaign of rooms full of red glass enemies. Grab their guns, throw what's empty, punch, slide and shatter your way to the exit. Every kill breaks into a thousand pieces.

• Story missions, plus Professional levels for the best players
• Endless mode: how many waves can you survive?
• Squad up with up to 3 friends. Time runs when ANY of you move
• Unlock weapon skins, arms, kill effects and more from cases and the shop
• Daily challenges and a season pass
• Full support for PC, phone, tablet and console

Think fast. Move slow. Don't get hit.

(Game was heavily inspired by and influenced by the game SuperHot)
